title: A worker near its turn cap commits its work in progress instead of exiting with staged changes
goal: Retrospective of SP-lyfnpu37: the TK-ye4msgps worker (a code task: bl_land.py, an e2e test and two docs) hit its 60-turn cap (error_max_turns, 61 turns) with its change staged and not committed, so the orchestrator had to resume it for 10 more turns to commit and record its gate. A worker that nears its cap commits what it has on work/<id> with KB-Work and reports what is left, and a code task's cap fits work that adds an e2e test and docs.

run: import sys;t=open('.claude/agents/kb-worker.md',encoding='utf-8').read();sys.exit(0 if 'work in progress' in t and 'turn cap' in t else 1)
